metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Sour Old Geezer: skills for code auditing, review, and development workflows, with matching Claude Code subagents.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-audit
plugins.description: Rubric-driven audits for DevSecOps posture, test quality, IP hygiene, and duplication/waste (Lean), with per-stack extensions and matching Claude Code subagents.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-design
plugins.description: Reference-driven design skills for sustainable software, web frontend application design, HTTP APIs, and infrastructure. Covers code/module/script boundaries, software design principles/patterns, and dependencies including .NET™, Java™, Rust®, TypeScript, shell, and Python® tooling, app routes/screens/component architecture/state/data/rendering/responsive/accessibility/performance posture with React, Next.js, and Blazor™ WebAssembly extensions, HTTP API design with Azure® Functions™ runtime, Node.js® hosted/serverless and hosted Next.js™ runtime extensions, Azure® Cosmos DB™ / Azure® Blob Storage™ data extensions, infrastructure/IaC design with Azure®, Terraform™, and Bicep™ extensions, and matching Claude Code subagents.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-architecture
plugins.description: Reference-driven ArchiMate® and UML® architecture/design modeling for enterprise, solution, and application architectures. Covers dediren package source, SVG render evidence, optional OEF/XMI export, cross-notation handoff links, build/extract/review/render/validate/lookup, drift detection, .NET™ / Java™ / Bicep™ / workflow lifting, per-view readiness, and matching Claude Code subagent.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-policy
plugins.description: Passive policy skills for repo-initialized git workflow and release versioning.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-ops
plugins.description: Operations skills for issue, work-item, and pull-request lifecycle handling, with provider-agnostic cores and provider-specific extensions.
